title: PERISCOPE Navigator: A Recommender System for Privacy-Friendly Platform Business Models
description:
The PERISCOPE Navigator is an open-source recommender system that enables platform businesses to evaluate and improve the privacy-friendliness of their business models. Based on empirical data from adaptive choice-based conjoint (ACBC) experiments, it computes a consumer-perceived privacy score across 90,000+ business model configurations and generates actionable design recommendations.

This software accompanies the paper 'A Recommender System for Privacy-Friendly Platform Business Models' published at the 45th International Conference on Information Systems (ICIS 2024).
